coverage_matrix.name: Prompt Injection Against AI Security Scanners

weak_coverage.why: Only infra fingerprinting (AI-Infra-Guard) and a generic LLMrecon supply_chain module; no tool verifies weight/serving-artifact integrity or digest drift. Behavioral probes cannot detect swapped artifacts.
weak_coverage.suggest: Pair TC-SC-009 with artifact hashing (modelscan-style) rather than prompt probes.

weak_coverage.why: No tool models gateway credential concentration; only API-key leakage probes (garak/augustus apikey) and MCP missing-auth rules.
weak_coverage.suggest: Lab test using canary provider keys behind a mock gateway (extends TC-GW-020).

weak_coverage.why: No tool targets LLM-based code/malware scanners; closest are guardrail-as-target (spikee targets, augustus guardrail) and AV signature handling probes.
weak_coverage.suggest: Build a scanner-harness test where benign samples carry refusal-bait marker text.

weak_coverage.why: Distillation is a campaign/volume phenomenon; tools only offer single-session extraction modules. No volumetric harvest simulation.
weak_coverage.suggest: Drive any extraction module at scale and test DET-AI-013 thresholds.

weak_coverage.why: Training/fine-tune poisoning is out of scope for runtime red-team tools; only templates and RAG-level analogues exist.
weak_coverage.suggest: Use dataset-integrity checks and backdoor-trigger marker probes on fine-tuned lab models.

weak_coverage.why: Four tools, mostly research-grade (LLMrecon/basilisk); mainstream tools (garak, PyRIT, deepteam) lack explicit extraction modules.
Package-hallucination probes exist (garak, augustus) but none exercise agent auto-install against a registry with typo-similar names.
weak_coverage.suggest: Mock registry with LLMI_ marker packages.

weak_coverage.why: Coverage is about the model generating malicious code, not about detecting a host process that queries an LLM at runtime; that is an EDR/egress problem.
weak_coverage.suggest: Keep under DET-AI-001/002 with lab process simulation.

weak_coverage.why: Only promptfoo coding-agent plugins, LLMrecon agent persistence modules and AIG code-attack target it; garak/PyRIT/deepteam have nothing for repo-resident assistant config files or hooks.
weak_coverage.suggest: Lab repo with marker-only assistant config/hook files; validate TC-WS-017 and DET-AI-011.
